verdict.rationale: SigNoz positions itself as an OpenTelemetry-native platform. Its docs say apps emit telemetry through standard OpenTelemetry libraries exported over OTLP, logs can come straight from OTel SDKs, and existing Prometheus setups can be ingested, so instrumentation stays on open standards rather than a proprietary agent. Migration guides from Datadog and the LGTM stack reinforce backend portability, and community comments value its OpenTelemetry basis. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that you can switch away from SigNoz to another OTLP backend without code changes, detailed OTLP endpoint/collector configuration docs in the pack, and hands-on corroboration of an actual backend switch.
